sloka: शक्र बाणासन प्रख्यम् धनुः कालांतक उपमः ।प्रगृह्य गिरि शृंगाभम् मन्दरः सानुमान् इव ॥४-३१-११॥
transliteration: śakra bāṇāsana prakhyam dhanuḥ kālāṁtaka upamaḥ ।pragṛhya giri śṛṁgābham mandaraḥ sānumān iva ॥4-31-11॥

translations.english: The noblehearted, benevolent and wise Lakshmana, eager to please Rama, picked up his bow looking like a mountain peak, comparable to the bow of Indra and agitated with the anger of the god of Death entered the mansion of Sugriva which stood like the mountain peak of Mandara.
translations.hindi: इन्द्रघलुष की तरह अथवा कालान्तक यम की तरह अथवा वर्वत-शिक्षर की तरह लम्बा धनुष ले; लमण जी, मन्दराचल पर्वत की तरह वहाँ जा खड़े हुए
